featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Krishna Automobiles while servicing my Honda Unicorn 150.

First, I was forced to purchase a new AMC contract just to unlock the last remaining service from my previous contract, which already felt unfair. On top of that, I was charged a very hefty amount for the service.

After the servicing was completed, my bike immediately started developing serious issues such as difficulty starting and engine oil leakage. When I took the bike back to them, they admitted that the engine gasket had not been sealed properly. This level of carelessness is unacceptable because if the leakage had gone unnoticed, it could have resulted in severe engine damage or even engine seizure. The only response I received from them was an apology.

Even after this, the bike’s starting issue continued. Later, a friend inspected the bike and found that the carburetor was blocked and apparently had not been cleaned during servicing. He also checked the engine oil and other consumables and pointed out that the bike did not appear to have been properly serviced at all despite the high charges.

Overall, this was a highly unprofessional and careless service experience. I expected proper servicing and accountability, especially after paying such a high amount, but instead ended up with more problems than before. I would not recommend this service center based on my experience.
